## Update history
* [ninja](https://runescape.wiki/w/Ninja_updates "Ninja updates") **9 October 2017 ( [Update](https://runescape.wiki/w/Update:Patch_Notes_(9_October_2017) "Update:Patch Notes (9 October 2017)") ):**
+ Free players can now smith bronze, iron, steel, mithril, adamant and rune pickaxes after completing The Perils of Ice Mountain.

...

* [update](https://runescape.wiki/w/Game_updates "Game updates") **27 May 2003 ( [Update](https://runescape.wiki/w/Update:Sleeping_bags_and_pickaxes "Update:Sleeping bags and pickaxes") ):**
+ Renamed Pickaxe to Bronze pickaxe.
+ Added Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, and Rune pickaxes to the game.

## Trivia
* Prior to the [Mining and Smithing rework](https://runescape.wiki/w/Mining_and_Smithing_rework "Mining and Smithing rework") , pickaxes required certain [Attack](https://runescape.wiki/w/Attack "Attack") levels to be wielded, depending on their type. They had the same accuracy as other weapons of their type, but only did about half as much damage.
